## Canvas and sidebar layout repair
- Fixes the Canvas hero overlay so the selected theme title, description, actions, and metadata stay inside the artwork card on macOS 26. - Constrains the split-view shell to the window viewport so vertical scrolling cannot push the sidebar below the visible window. - Keeps the sidebar's connection status and themed-Codex action visible with a natural-height footer at compact and tall window sizes. - Preserves the existing theme application, local Apple wallpaper shelves, DockDoor launcher, and Sparkle update behavior.

# Codex Studio 0.1.6
## Studio interface overhaul
- Reworks the app shell with a calmer Apple-inspired split-view workspace. - Refreshes Canvas, Themes, Live Lab, Library, and Settings with native-feeling materials, controls, typography, and spacing. - Expands the local theme library presentation with wider cards, clearer categories, and more comfortable gallery density. - Includes the current official Apple macOS, iOS, and iPadOS wallpaper shelves in this user-directed offline release artifact; each pack retains its local-only provenance record and attribution.
## Sidebar and window layout
- Reserves the native titlebar area so the Studio brand never collides with traffic lights. - Separates scrollable navigation from the persistent runtime and themed-Codex actions. - Pins the connection status and launch action to the bottom of the sidebar at any window height. - Keeps the build launcher from replacing a live executable, preventing stale temporary-bundle signature races during rebuilds.
## Update delivery
- Keeps the internal Sparkle build number monotonic with the existing release feed so 0.1.6 is offered normally by Check for Updates.

## DockDoor identity repair
- Uses the stock Codex dark-mode icon for the themed helper shortcut. - Repairs a helper pin that DockDoor has re-associated with the official `com.openai.codex` process. - Hides the official process from DockDoor's unpinned running-app row when the managed helper pin is present, preventing a second swirl-branded Codex item.
